instructions: Instantly compact surface: four tools. 1) instantly_find: describe what you want in plain words; get ranked command IDs. 2) instantly_describe: load the full input schema for one command ID. 3) instantly_preview: for any write, validate and plan it without sending anything; returns a one-use token. 4) instantly_run: mode read runs a read command; mode write takes only the preview token. Always confirm the workspace first with instantly_run command_id=status. Pass the same profile and workspace_id on every call; one process serves one profile. Writes are refused unless the host enabled them. Features marked unavailable have no supported command; say so instead of guessing.

tools.find: Search Instantly commands by plain-language intent. Returns ranked command IDs with effect and availability. Needs no credentials. Start here, then call instantly_describe.
tools.describe: Return the full input schema, examples, effect, cost and CLI flags for one command ID from instantly_find. Needs no credentials.
tools.preview: Validate a command and show the exact request it would send, without sending it. Returns a one-use preview token valid for five minutes. Never mutates.
tools.run: Execute. mode read: run a read command by ID with arguments. mode write: pass only the preview_token from instantly_preview; arguments cannot change. Use command_id status first to confirm profile and workspace.
